svg.title: The Repo Is the Shared Memory
svg.desc: Public poster showing the workflow of the Autonomous Agentic Research Swarm framework, from locked definitions through Planner, Worker, Judge execution and a concrete research artifact pipeline.

text.font-family: Iowan Old Style, Palatino Linotype, Book Antiqua, Georgia, serif
Iowan Old Style, Palatino Linotype, Book Antiqua, Georgia, serif

svg.text: A file-based workflow for running multiple research agents
in parallel without letting definitions drift, tasks
collide, or outputs become unauditable. This poster maps
the actual framework in this repository, from locked
and git history do the coordination.
and every task is judged against

text.font-family: Iowan Old Style, Palatino Linotype, Book Antiqua, Georgia, serif

svg.text: Lock the Definitions Before Work Begins
The framework starts by reducing scientific ambiguity. Definitions, schemas, ownership boundaries,
and task contracts are all written down before workers execute.

text.font-family: Iowan Old Style, Palatino Linotype, Book Antiqua, Georgia, serif
Iowan Old Style, Palatino Linotype, Book Antiqua, Georgia, serif

svg.text: Codex executes the task, writes only inside scope,
and leaves durable notes in the repo.
Only the Planner moves the task file across
lifecycle folders until it reaches review or done.

text.font-family: Iowan Old Style, Palatino Linotype, Book Antiqua, Georgia, serif
Iowan Old Style, Palatino Linotype, Book Antiqua, Georgia, serif
Iowan Old Style, Palatino Linotype, Book Antiqua, Georgia, serif

svg.text: Artifact Pipeline: What a Research Slice Actually Produces
The public-facing result is not just code execution. The framework turns one task chain into
evidence, validation, and a visible output.

text.font-family: Iowan Old Style, Palatino Linotype, Book Antiqua, Georgia, serif

svg.text: Concrete Vertical Slice in This Repository
Is Ethereum L1's settlement take rate on rollup
economics rising, stable, or decaying as L2 usage

text.font-family: SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

svg.text: This is not 'AI agents chatting.' It is a
reproducible workflow where the repo behaves like
The framework's public value is not
just speed. It is parallel research
outputs, and a built-in audit trail.
If you hang one piece in a gallery, it should communicate
that the hard problem is not "how do we run more agents?"
but "how do we keep many agents scientifically coherent?"
